description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] For sellers taking x402 or other stablecoin payments: give the network, the settlement transaction (EVM hash or Solana signature) and your payout address, and optionally the asset, minimum amount (base units) and payer. Reads the chain itself and answers verdict "paid", "not_paid" (failed, or no matching transfer to you) or "unknown" (not found yet), with every token transfer it saw. Networks: eip155:84532, eip155:8453, eip155:1, eip155:137, eip155:42161, eip155:10, eip155:43114, eip155:1329, eip155:130, eip155:146, eip155:480, eip155:5042, eip155:999, solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp, solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1. A match proves tokens reached you; it does not prove what they were for.

amount.description: minimum amount in base units (USDC: 1 USD = 1000000)

asset.description: token contract (EVM) or mint (Solana) you expect; omit to accept any token

network.description: CAIP-2 id, one of: eip155:84532, eip155:8453, eip155:1, eip155:137, eip155:42161, eip155:10, eip155:43114, eip155:1329, eip155:130, eip155:146, eip155:480, eip155:5042, eip155:999, solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp, solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1

payTo.description: your payout address (EVM 0x... or Solana base58)

payer.description: the address you expect the payment from

tx.description: EVM transaction hash (0x + 64 hex) or Solana transaction signature (base58)
